transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I’ve just been feeling really low for a long time. I wake up and it’s already there, like this heavy gray feeling, before I even get to the clinic. And it pretty much stays with me through the whole day.
How long have you been feeling this low?
It’s been about two years and a couple months now. It started around when the clinic staffing changed and my schedule started rotating all over the place.
Do you still find pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I know I’ve been feeling low most of the time, but I haven’t paid close attention to whether things feel enjoyable or not.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t really been paying attention to whether I’m interested or not. I just know I’ve been feeling low most days.
Have you noticed any change in how much you enjoy activities or hobbies since you started feeling low?
I really haven’t noticed clearly. I know I’ve been feeling low, but I haven’t been keeping track of whether hobbies or activities feel different.
Do you feel like you've been enjoying things less than you used to?
I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed it in a clear way. I just know I’ve been feeling down a lot, but I can’t say for sure if I’m enjoying things less.
Have you noticed any activities that you used to find pleasurable, but now you don't find pleasurable at all?
I can’t really point to anything specific like that. I haven’t noticed a clear activity that used to feel good and now feels like nothing. I just haven’t been paying close attention to it, I guess.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in social activities or being around other people?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear change with being around people. I mean, sometimes I keep to myself, but I can’t say I’ve specifically lost interest in social stuff.
Do you feel like things that used to make you happy no longer make you happy?
I’m not sure. I know I feel down a lot, but I can’t really tell if the things that used to make me happy don’t anymore. I haven’t paid close enough attention to say that for sure.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that most people would find enjoyable?
I don’t really know. I haven’t thought of it that way, like whether I can’t feel pleasure at all. I know I’m down a lot, but I can’t say for sure that enjoyable things don’t feel enjoyable to me.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that you used to find enjoyable?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I know I don’t feel great most of the time, but I can’t say clearly that I’m unable to enjoy things I used to like. I just haven’t really noticed it that specifically.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from activities or things that you used to find enjoyable?
I’m still not sure. I don’t think I can say I’m unable to feel pleasure from things I used to enjoy. I just haven’t really noticed it in that clear of a way.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that you used to find enjoyable?
I honestly don’t know. I can’t really point to something I used to enjoy and say it gives me no pleasure now. I just haven’t been paying attention to it that way.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that you used to find enjoyable?
I don’t really have a clear answer. I know you’ve asked it a few times, but I honestly haven’t noticed it in that specific way—like I can’t say for sure that I’m unable to enjoy things I used to.
Can you think of anything that you currently enjoy or find pleasure in?
I’m not sure. Nothing really comes to mind right away. I mean, there might be small things here and there, but I can’t think of anything I’d clearly say I enjoy right now.
Can you remember the last time you felt any pleasure or enjoyment from something?
I’m not sure. I’m trying to think of a specific time, but nothing really stands out to me. I guess I haven’t been paying attention to moments like that.
Have you felt pleasure or enjoyed anything at all in the past two weeks?
I honestly don’t know. I can’t think of anything from the last two weeks where I clearly felt pleasure or enjoyment. Nothing really stands out.
Have you felt any pleasure at all in the past two months?
I’m not really sure. Looking back over two months, I can’t point to anything where I clearly felt pleasure. Maybe there were small moments, but nothing that I noticed or remember as enjoyable.
Do you feel like you're unable to feel pleasure or enjoy things most of the time?
I don’t really know. It feels like I don’t notice much enjoyment most of the time, but I’m not sure if I’m completely unable to feel it. I just can’t think of clear examples.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that most people would find enjoyable?
I’m not sure. I guess things that are supposed to be enjoyable don’t really feel like much to me, but I don’t know if that means I’m unable to feel pleasure. It’s more like I just don’t notice it.
